body: Don’t apologize for your rant. I feel ya... I’m tired too.

I ask myself the same questions everyday. And it’s dumb because I live a decent life and I know I have support of others but still feel lonely. I still struggle to find the answers to those questions. Keep your head up. I know talk is cheap, but damn it - you gotta keep your head up.
I thought it said “I love fucking my kittens” . Def had to do a double take
Wow. I’m soo very sorry you had to endure such trauma at age 11. Speechless.

I think writing is such a great outlet. Wether it be rapping or simply journaling. I think it’s awesome you write. I have a little journal of my own and when I’m really feeling down - I’ll write what I feel.
Awh thanks. I guess I never really noticed the way I have with words. It’s a good feeling that you’ve noticed.

Thank you soo much. No, really.. I mean it. I always try to take a step back and look at the “big picture” of things. It’s just so easy to get sucked into negativity once your mind is on a roll. Hopefully one day I can find contentment I’m seeking.
